बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों में फिल्म Ramayana के चर्चे हो रहे हैं और सेलेब्स के ऑनेस्ट रिव्यू सामने आ गए हैं! 🎬

रणबीर कपूर और यश की फिल्म Ramayana Part One को लेकर शुरुआती बॉक्स ऑफिस ट्रेंड्स में इसके भारत में पहले दिन 65 करोड़ रुपये कमाने की उम्मीद जताई जा रही है। 📈

डायरेक्टर करण जौहर ने रणबीर कपूर और पूरी स्टार कास्ट की जमकर तारीफ की है, वहीं रैपर बादशाह ने फिल्म देखकर इमोशनल होने की बात कबूली है। 🤩

आलिया भट्ट ने भी पति रणबीर की फिल्म की तारीफ करते हुए खुद को एक 'प्राउड' वाइफ बताया और सेट से रणबीर व बेटी राहा की तस्वीरें शेयर कीं। 💖

क्या आप सिनेमाघरों में Ranbir Kapoor और Yash की इस माइथोलॉजिकल एपिक फिल्म को देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 🍿

#CineChaska #Ramayana #RanbirKapoor #KaranJohar #Badshah #AliaBhatt #BollywoodNews

ctx.title: Celebrities' Honest Review of Ramayana: Karan Johar praises Ranbir Kapoor & entire cast, Badshah admits getting emotional
ctx.summary:
Ramayana: Part 1 released worldwide on November 5. Produced by Nitesh Tiwari, the epic saga recorded a historic opening day. Apart from setting box office records, Ramayana has also received positive reviews. While the movie is expected to pull huge crowds to theatres, many celebrities have already shared their reviews. From Karan Johar to Badshah and Kunal Kapoor, many praised its performances, music, and cinematic scale. 
 Taking to his Instagram handle,  Karan Johar  shared a lengthy post. The acclaimed filmmaker lauded the film's entire cast and described Ramayana as a story deeply rooted in India's cultural heritage. He wrote, "RAMAYANA ….. a story immersed in our cultural veins… a story generations have grown up on… a story that is an embodiment of Values, traditions and pure humanity…. You have read it, seen it, told it… and YET to be BLOWN away by its cinematic adaptation is no short of a Miracle! I salute, I applaud, and I have the deepest respect for each and every team member of Ramayana…. All of us can dream it… they actually went out and achieved it!!!!" 
 He went on to appreciate Nitesh Tiwari, Yash, Ravie Dubey and  Ranbir Kapoor . Lastly, Karan added, "Am an inspired filmmaker and a proud Indian cinegoer today… GO WATCH this divine blessing of a film with your families as soon as you can." 
 Further, Badshah admitted to getting emotional after watching the movie. He showered praise on every actor and gave a special shoutout to Mukesh Chhabra for the casting.
